features.name: Termux RUN_COMMAND Integration
features.description: Send shell commands to Termux via RUN_COMMAND intent, receive results via PendingIntent with Bundle extraction

features.name: APK Download & Install Pipeline
features.description: Download Termux and Termux:X11 APKs from GitHub Releases via OkHttp, install via PackageInstaller session API

features.name: Setup Step Orchestration
features.description: 7-step setup wizard with sealed class states, success marker detection, idempotent retry, and reactive UI

features.name: proot-distro Environment Setup
features.description: Manual rootfs extraction fallback, DNS config, full JDK install, idempotent setup with positive verification

features.name: X11 Display via Termux:X11
features.description: Socket bind-mount, DISPLAY env, preference broadcast (fullscreen, no keyboard bar), auto-switch to X11

features.name: RuneLite Launcher Launch
features.description: Always-run-launcher (auto-updates client jars), --scale 2 for UI scaling, RUNELITE_VMARGS for -Xmx4g/G1GC, openbox WM auto-maximize, process cleanup via EXIT trap

features.name: Dual-Output Logging (AppLog)
features.description: Logcat + on-device file logging with structured prefixes, session rotation, CleanupManager

features.name: Permissions Setup Flow
features.description: 3-phase guided permissions (Termux config + RUN_COMMAND + battery optimization), auto-poll on resume, reactive state

features.name: Shell Script Deployment (ScriptManager)
features.description: APK assets extraction, CRLF stripping, deploy to Termux via RUN_COMMAND stdin

features.name: OAuth Step 1 (Account Auth)
features.description: PKCE S256 with com_jagex_auth_desktop_launcher client, jagex: scheme capture via intent filter, code exchange

features.name: GeckoView Auth (Both OAuth Steps)
features.description: GeckoAuthActivity handles both OAuth steps in single GeckoView session, passes Cloudflare, intercepts port 80 redirect

features.name: Credential Storage & Transport
features.description: EncryptedSharedPreferences with AES-256-GCM, env file via stdin to Termux, toString() redaction

features.name: Security Hardening
features.description: Session 22 initial (15 fixes) + Session 37 production hardening (21 more fixes): shell injection, credential scrubbing, PendingIntent flags, allowBackup, FLAG_SECURE, corruption recovery

features.name: Game Session API Integration
features.description: POST id_token to /sessions, GET /accounts with sessionId Bearer. Correct two-step call order. Pre-launch session validation with auto-reauth on expiry.
features.notes: Session 45: Added SessionValidation sealed class + validateSession(). Pre-launch validation auto-triggers re-auth on expired session. Awaiting on-device E2E test.

features.name: Session Lifecycle (Foreground Service)
features.description: RuneLiteSessionService with START_STICKY, notification with Switch/Stop actions, keeps game alive on swipe

features.name: Session Health Monitor
features.description: 15s poll interval, sentinel file verification, 3-consecutive failure debounce before marking dead

features.name: GPU Acceleration (Mali VirGL / Adreno Turnip)
features.description: lfdevs Mesa install, VirGL+ANGLE server, virpipe Gallium driver, Zink+Turnip for Adreno, dynamic Mesa version from GitHub API, runtime auto-detection with software fallback
features.notes: Session 62: VirGL and the real GPU plugin path are working in validated internal-hybrid runs, but sustained throughput is still far below 120 FPS. Runtime identity is now proven for the app-owned host and app-process X server copies of libXlorie.so. The current hot path is DamageTraceV2 PutImage on WINDOW with backend=other from the extracted server library; exact symbol/offset mapping is the next step.

features.name: Session-Aware UI
features.description: Launch/Switch/Stop buttons, elapsed time display, checkSession on resume, session state observation

features.name: Ordered Shutdown
features.description: shutdown-session.sh performs ordered teardown of Java/proot/openbox/PulseAudio/X11 processes

features.name: Persistent Setup State
features.description: Two-layer state (Termux marker files + SharedPreferences), version-gated re-setup, startup reconciliation via check-markers.sh
